description: Groups data by weather_condition and calculates the count of fatal injuries for each group after filtering records where injuries_fatal > 0.
when_to_use: When you need to group data by weather_condition, filter for records with fatal injuries, and calculate the count of such incidents.
what_it_does: Step 1: Filter the dataset to include only records where injuries_fatal is greater than 0. Step 2: Group the data by weather_condition. Step 3: Calculate the count of fatal injuries for each weather condition group. Step 4: Sort the results to identify which weather conditions have the highest and lowest counts of fatal injuries.
